content:
Jules: quick sync on a "compat shim" approach for precision profiles. Goal: let infra map incoming profile identifiers to a safe runtime profile without forcing immediate model rebuilds.
Ravi: sounds useful for tenant lockdowns (eg enterprise->int8). Two execution styles: mapping-only (runtime substitution) vs materialize (CI produces converted artifacts).
Mei: mapping-only is fast but opaque. We need deterministic traceability: what was requested vs what actually ran.
Theo: propose adding header: X-precision-effective: <orig>::<resolved>. Runtime should log resolved_profile and kernel_tag. That lets eval correlate deg_score by resolved profile.
Jules: also need a conservative matching rule: require quant_fingerprint match (hash of scales/affine params) or else refuse mapping unless owner approves. Avoid unsafe fp8->int4 blind swaps.
Ravi: onboarding linter action: warn on ambiguous names or missing fingerprint. Owners must ack mapping opt-in.
Mei: ops runbook sketch:
```
monitor: deg_score, latency, hallucination_rate
if deg_score_delta > 0.05 -> disable mapping for model, notify owner, start shadow-compare
warmup: run 5 warmup requests after enabling mapping to seed kv caches
```
Theo: console UX: show "effective precision" on model page and a link to last shadow-compare. API: GET /models/{id}/effective_precision.
Jules: policy: default mapping allowed in dev, disabled in hosted prod unless tenant opts in; dedicated/private can choose materialize-by-default.
Ravi: action items: 1) schema for shim mappings (Ravi) 2) runtime header + logging (Theo) 3) onboarding linter + owner ack flow (Mei) 4) eval join for deg_score by resolved_profile (Jules).
ops-bot: ticket created: QUANT-SHIM-1101 assigned to eng-ml.
Mei: I'll draft the linter message and owner ack UI.
Theo: I'll prototype header logging and kernel_tag; will include quant_fingerprint in logs.
Jules: keep mappings explicit (no wildcards) and conservative. We'll reconvene Tuesday for design review. :thumbsup:
